lines.gurmukhi: ਛਛੈ ਛਾਇਆ ਵਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhachhai chhaaiaa varatee sabh a(n)tar teraa keeaa bharam hoaa ||
lines.translation: Chhachha: Ignorance exists within everyone; doubt is Your doing, O Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਭੁਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: bharam upaai bhulaaeean aape teraa karam hoaa tinh guroo miliaa ||10||
lines.translation: Having created doubt, You Yourself cause them to wander in delusion; those whom You bless with Your Mercy meet with the Guru. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਜੈ ਜਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਭੀਖ ਭਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jajai jaan ma(n)gat jan jaachai lakh chauraaseeh bheekh bhaviaa ||
lines.translation: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4 million incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: eko levai eko devai avar na doojaa mai suniaa ||11||
lines.translation: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਝੈ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸੁ ਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhajhai jhoor marahu kiaa praanee jo kichh denaa s de rahiaa ||
lines.translation: Jhajha: O mortal being, why are you dying of anxiety? Whatever the Lord is to give, He shall keep on giving.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇ ਦੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: de de vekhai hukam chalaae jiu jeeaa kaa rijak paiaa ||12||
lines.translation: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues, His beings receive nourishment. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਞੰਞੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਦੇਖਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: nja(n)njai nadar kare jaa dekhaa doojaa koee naahee ||
lines.translation: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਏਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: eko rav rahiaa sabh thaaee ek vasiaa man maahee ||13||
lines.translation: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਟਟੈ ਟੰਚੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਘੜੀ ਕਿ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tatai ta(n)ch karahu kiaa praanee ghaRee k muhat k uth chalanaa ||
lines.translation: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shall have to get up and depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰਹੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਜਿ ਪੜਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: jooai janam na haarahu apanaa bhaaj paRahu tum har saranaa ||14||
lines.translation: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਠੈ ਠਾਢਿ ਵਰਤੀ ਤਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thathai thaadh varatee tin a(n)tar har charanee jinh kaa chit laagaa ||
lines.translation: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ਤਉ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: chit laagaa seee jan nisatare tau parasaadee sukh paaiaa ||15||
lines.translation: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace, they obtain peace. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਡੈ ਡੰਫੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਚਲਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dadai da(n)ph karahu kiaa praanee jo kichh hoaa s sabh chalanaa ||
lines.translation: Dadda: Why do you make such ostentatious shows, O mortal? Whatever exists, shall all pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: tisai sarevahu taa sukh paavahu sarab nira(n)tar rav rahiaa ||16||
lines.translation: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtain peace. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਢੈ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhai dhaahi usaarai aape jiu tis bhaavai tivai kare ||
lines.translation: Dhadha: He Himself establishes and disestablishes; as it pleases His Will, so does He act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar kar vekhai hukam chalaae tis nisataare jaa kau nadar kare ||17||
lines.translation: Having created the creation, He watches over it; He issues His Commands, and emancipates those, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਣਾਣੈ ਰਵਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanai ravat rahai ghat a(n)tar har gun gaavai soee ||
lines.translation: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap milaae karataa punarap janam na hoee ||18||
lines.translation: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਰੂ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tatai taaroo bhavajal hoaa taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Tatta: The terrible world-ocean is so very deep; its limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਰ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਮ ਬੂਡਸਿ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇਹਿ ਤਾਰਣ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naa tar naa tulahaa ham boodas taar lehi taaran raaiaa ||19||
lines.translation: I do not have a boat, or even a raft; I am drowning - save me, O Savior King! ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਥਾਨੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: thathai thaan thaana(n)tar soee jaa kaa keeaa sabh hoaa ||
lines.translation: T'hat'ha: In all places and interspaces, He is; everything which exists, is by His doing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa bharam kiaa maaiaa kaheeai jo tis bhaavai soee bhalaa ||20||
lines.translation: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਦੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੋਸੁ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਆਪਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dadai dos na deoo kisai dos kara(n)maa aapaniaa ||
lines.translation: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੀਜੈ ਅਵਰ ਜਨਾ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo mai keeaa so mai paaiaa dos na deejai avar janaa ||21||
lines.translation: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੀਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhai dhaar kalaa jin chhodee har cheejee jin ra(n)g keeaa ||
lines.translation: Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਦੀਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੀਆ ਕਰਮੀ ਕਰਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: tis daa deeaa sabhanee leeaa karamee karamee hukam paiaa ||22||
lines.translation: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੰਨੈ ਨਾਹ ਭੋਗ ਨਿਤ ਭੋਗੈ ਨਾ ਡੀਠਾ ਨਾ ਸੰਮ੍ਹਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: na(n)nai naah bhog nit bhogai naa deethaa naa sa(n)mhaliaa ||
lines.translation: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲੀ ਹਉ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਭੈਣੇ ਕੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: galee hau sohaagan bhaine ka(n)t na kabahoo(n) mai miliaa ||23||
lines.translation: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਵੇਖਣ ਕਉ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: papai paatisaahu paramesar vekhan kau parapa(n)ch keeaa ||
lines.translation: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watches over it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: dekhai boojhai sabh kichh jaanai a(n)tar baahar rav rahiaa ||24||
lines.translation: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fully pervading. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਫੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਸਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਲਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phaphai phaahee sabh jag phaasaa jam kai sa(n)gal ba(n)dh laiaa ||
lines.translation: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by its chains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸੇ ਨਰ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਭਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee se nar ubare j har saranaagat bhaj paiaa ||25||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਬੈ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਜੁਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: babai baajee khelan laagaa chaupaR keete chaar jugaa ||
lines.translation: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages.
